sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: In terms of gameplay mechanics, Red Ball Jumper features a range of modes, including normal mode, hard mode, and endless mode. Endless mode is a survival mode where players must navigate through a randomly generated level with increasing difficulty, with the goal of surviving for as long as possible.
